semantics.rust_signature: fn tensor_view_as_exact_native(input: &Tensor, other: &Tensor, cancellation: &CancellationToken) -> Result<Tensor, ShapeLayoutTransformPartTwoError>
semantics.alias_rule: read-only alias of input storage only
semantics.shape_rule: target shape equals other.shape and must be compatible with input strides and element count
semantics.dtype_rule: input dtype is preserved and other dtype is irrelevant
semantics.layout_rule: TensorDescriptor is the sole compatible-view validator
semantics.device_rule: input device is preserved and streams must agree
semantics.cancellation_points: before validation and before returning the alias
semantics.vjp_rule: inverse view to the input shape
semantics.jvp_rule: apply the same view to the tangent
